Data & execution provenance

Dataset
Deterministically generated synthetic payments; no customer or employer data.
Snapshot
September 1–30, 2026 · INR only
Hosted computation
Browser-based rule engine; supported question routing; no external AI calls.
Case storage
Local to this browser. Notes and review status do not sync between reviewers.
Audit boundary
Downloadable review snapshots, not a tamper-proof enterprise audit trail.
Snowflake implementation
Python Streamlit app, parameterized Snowflake queries, SQL rule views; requires account setup.
